capture.description: Capabilities for KANG's quick-capture overlay window (NFR-011): hide/show/focus and listening for the Rust-emitted 'shown' event, so the frontend can dismiss itself after Enter/Escape without a round-trip through a custom command. No filesystem, shell, network, or tray capabilities — same pure-API-client posture as capabilities/default.json.

default.description: Capabilities for KANG's main window: tray, global shortcut, window show/hide only. No filesystem, shell, or network capabilities — the shell is a pure API client (UI-P1) and has no business needing them.
